messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
int sum(int a[], int n) { return a[n - 1] + sum(a, n - 1); }
// a = {1, 2, 3}

Question: What is sum(a, 3)?
The student answered: 6

The student holds this wrong belief and does not know it is wrong: Recursion stops by itself when the work is done

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["a[n-1] se 3, phir 2, phir 1 add hota jaayega, jab kaam khatam hoga recursion khud ruk jaayega.", "Jab n chhota hota jaayega toh function apne aap stop ho jaayega, isliye 1+2+3=6 aayega.", "sum har call me pichhla element jodta hai, aur jab array khatam ho jaata hai toh recursion apne aap ruk jaata hai.", "Pehle 3 add, phir 2, phir 1, total 6; jaise hi jodne ka kaam pura hua, recursion band ho gaya.", "n-1 karte karte jab tak elements bache hain tab tak add hota rahega, phir khud hi stop ho jaayega, answer 6."]}

sentences: a[n-1] se 3, phir 2, phir 1 add hota jaayega, jab kaam khatam hoga recursion khud ruk jaayega.
Jab n chhota hota jaayega toh function apne aap stop ho jaayega, isliye 1+2+3=6 aayega.
sum har call me pichhla element jodta hai, aur jab array khatam ho jaata hai toh recursion apne aap ruk jaata hai.
Pehle 3 add, phir 2, phir 1, total 6; jaise hi jodne ka kaam pura hua, recursion band ho gaya.
n-1 karte karte jab tak elements bache hain tab tak add hota rahega, phir khud hi stop ho jaayega, answer 6.
